name: r5-l38-fade-boot
description: ⛓ THE FADE PROBE, HALF ONE — forty ticks of nothing at L38's L37 arrival. It exists to DECOMPOSE `r5-totem-entrance`'s 370 dead frames, and it found that the boot fade is NOT the 21 `r5-feather` measured: this level boots in TWENTY. A `blackCover` countdown and the frame `Bot.update` samples it on are two clocks, so the cost of a load is 19, 20 or 21 depending on their phase — which is why the ceremony's share had to be measured by subtraction rather than assumed from another tape's constants.
